title: Privacy-contract activation roadmap and OKR alignment for regulated private tenants
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Objective: Define and sequence a quarter-level roadmap that ties privacy-contract requirements (data residency, contractual DPA clauses, auditability) to activation milestones for regulated enterprise customers using Private/VPC/on-prem instances. This ticket synthesizes the product plan, success metrics, gating criteria, and cross-functional dependencies for the 2026-Q2 activation wave.

Background: Several inbound enterprise contracts require not only VPC/private deployment options but contract-level guarantees (e.g., specific KMS integrations, audit log retention, SLA language, and data residency). To hit commercial commitments we need a clearly sequenced roadmap that translates legal/contract asks into techncial deliverables, rollout gates, and OKR signals.

Scope:
- In-scope: deployment readiness checkpoints (KMS/HSM, audit logging schema, tenant isolation tests), documented activation runbook, per-tenant compliance checklist, and release gating for private activations.
- Out-of-scope: large-scale Dedicated capacity reservations, billing/commitment contract language edits (handled by GTM/legal).

Goals (quarter):
1) Deliver a repeatable activation runway that reduces time-to-activate from sales handoff to production by 40% for regulated tenants.
2) Ensure all private activations meet the signed privacy-contract checklist (KMS, audit logs, data residency) before SLA turn-up.
3) Surface OKR-linked telemetry (activation lead time, post-activation incidents, customer compliance exceptions) to the Console for PM/CS visibility.

High-level milestones:
- Milestone A (2026-04-10): Finalize privacy-contract checklist and automation spec.
- Milestone B (2026-04-30): Complete KMS/HSM integration templates and test harness.
- Milestone C (2026-05-15): Audit-log pipeline and retention policy implemented + end-to-end tenant activation dry-run.
- Milestone D (2026-05-25): Runbook, run-of-record checklist, and training for Solutions Engineering.
- Milestone E (2026-05-30): First regulated tenant activation window (pilot).

Rollout & gating:
- Canary: 2 internal pilot tenants in a mirrored VPC during the runbook dry-run.
- Gate 1 (security): KMS keys present and automated key-rotation verification passes.
- Gate 2 (observability): Audit logs are ingesting and retained to contract SLA for 30 days in pilot.
- Gate 3 (ops): Solutions Engineering checklist completed and playbook sign-off.
Only after all gates pass do we move pilot tenants to production activation and open the work for new contracts.

Acceptance criteria and guardrails are listed separately for engineering and operations below.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: KMS/HSM integration adds unexpected latency to startup paths. Mitigation: bench- and load-test integrations in isolated environment; pipeline to disable advanced features for activations that need faster TTR.
- Risk: Audit-log schema incompatibility across customer SIEMs. Mitigation: provide JSON schema and an adapter layer; include schema compatibility tests in CI.
- Risk: Misalignment between legal contract language and product guarantees. Mitigation: weekly sync with Legal and AMs; final checklist to be reviewed before signoff.

Communication plan: Weekly sync (PM/Eng/SRE/Legal/SE) on Fridays; pre-activation readiness review two weeks before pilot.

Deliverables: checklist, automation tasks (ENG tickets), runbook, test scripts, Console telemetry dashboard updates, SE training packet.
